status_definitions.current: May be selected as a formal entrypoint for a new cycle.
status_definitions.active_support: Used by a current pipeline but not selected directly by users.
status_definitions.verification: Tests contracts or implementations and does not produce model lineage.
status_definitions.diagnostic_only: May emit measurements but must not produce a formal model release.
status_definitions.maintained_compatibility: Kept to read or reproduce named historical receipts; not a default new-cycle entrypoint.
status_definitions.retired: Read-only historical evidence; must not be invoked for a new cycle.
